# Reject-only deterministic check families: schema conformance, length bounds,
# refusal detection, and required markers can each REJECT an output but none of
# them can witness adequacy (OMN-13373). A ``dod_deterministic`` band made up
# solely of these therefore has no promotion power and must not grant
# deterministic acceptance authority (OMN-13375).
_REJECT_ONLY_DETERMINISTIC_FRAGMENTS = ("refus", "schema", "length", "marker")


def _is_reject_only_deterministic_check(check: str) -> bool:
    """Return whether a deterministic check can only reject, never promote."""
    normalized = check.strip().lower()
    return any(
        fragment in normalized
        for fragment in _REJECT_ONLY_DETERMINISTIC_FRAGMENTS
    )


def _is_verifiable_deterministic_acceptance(
    gate_input: ModelQualityGateInput,
    dod_deterministic: tuple[str, ...],
) -> bool:
    """Return whether this contract path uses deterministic acceptance authority.

    Authority requires a verifiable task type AND at least one deterministic
    check that is not reject-only. Schema, length, no-refusal, and marker
    checks can each REJECT an output but none can witness adequacy, so a band
    containing only them must fall through to the adequacy-authority guard
    instead of promoting a clean output to ``passed=True`` (OMN-13375).
    """
    if gate_input.task_type not in _VERIFIABLE_TASK_TYPES:
        return False
    return any(
        not _is_reject_only_deterministic_check(check)
        for check in dod_deterministic
    )
